utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Mara! Have you heard? The Smiths are running that repair drive this Saturday—we're all supposed to bring in broken appliances and stuff to the community center!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I think there might be two drives—I've been focused on the community shed repair. Let me check with Cleo; she's organizing the donations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I didn't realize there were two! Well, the Smiths are definitely doing one—I can help you check with Cleo if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I pointed out that fence spot by the oak tree—should be fine for the crew to find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Bo! I’m trying to get a good group together—Faye and Nell are in for morning slots too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, good to know. I'll try to pop by with that toaster if I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, just checking in—need any help rounding up volunteers for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is this repair drive actually confirmed? I haven't seen any official notice or fliers around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's confirmed—Oren's got the sign-up sheet out, and I saw Leo getting things ready. Want me to grab you a flier from his place?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Leo, do you have a minute? I wanted to check on our inventory for the repair drive Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I've got the list. Tools are sorted in the garage. Need me to run through it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Leo. Could you double-check if we have enough screwdrivers? I’m bringing my lamp and want to make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Leo mentioned the repair drive is starting at 9 AM on Saturday, so we'll be ready for folks like Faye showing up around 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, so we have a solid crew for the early shift? I want to make sure we're not scrambling at 9.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Leo and I will be there from 9 to get everything set up, so we'll have a good head start before Faye arrives.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hey Vik! Are you here about the repair drive? I think it's this weekend... or maybe tomorrow? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it's this Saturday! I saw it on the community board near the park—definitely this weekend, not tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Vik! Saturday, right. I thought it might be tomorrow, but that's a relief. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I believe it's 9 sharp near Elm and Birch. That's what I'm planning around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that sounds right — Cleo mentioned we're low on tarps, so I'll grab some on my way there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, have you got a moment? I just cleaned out my shed and found a few extra wrenches—thought you might have a use for 'em.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's perfect timing! I was just thinking about the repair drive this Saturday—those wrenches will come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to hear it! I'll bring the whole toolbox along on Saturday—just in case anyone needs something else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me go check the shed now at 3 — can you meet me there so we can look at the drive together?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the shed. Um, what time is it now? I got a bit lost in thought there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's almost 2:30 now, so if we head over soon, we'll make it by 3. Can you come?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a solid count on the nails and wood, but we're still short on tarps. Have you looked around for any old ones?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I haven't checked my shed yet! Let me run home and dig through—I'm sure there's a couple of dusty tarps in there somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be fantastic, Quinn! Every tarp helps—just bring them by my garage when you find them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I heard a little about it. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's a community effort to fix up the neighborhood, scheduled for tomorrow near Elm and Birch. I've been keeping track of the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Ah, so it's a whole neighborhood thing. Did you say you're tracking the details? Maybe I could check in with you if I need to know where to drop off some old parts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa, glad you could make it. We're just setting up the tools now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli! Thanks for getting everything ready—I'm so glad we moved it to Sunday, the community center is working out great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the community center is perfect for this. Plenty of room to spread out the tools and work on things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we sorted out how we'll manage the flow of people dropping off items? I don't want any confusion.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I was thinking we could set up a sign-up sheet for time slots, that way people don't all show up at once.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good idea, but who's going to manage the sign-up sheet and make sure each time slot has enough helpers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Vik, did you hear about the repair drive? I think it's a good idea to fix things together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Rey, I was just telling Noah about it! It's this Saturday—I saw it on the community board near the park. We should definitely go!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, great! I've got a stubborn pipe under the sink that needs fixing, so I'll be there for sure.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Jules, which repair drive are we talking about? I want to make sure I don't mix up the community center fix with the shed project.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's the one at the community center this Saturday—I've been rounding up folks from my block to join in, and I think it'd be great to have you there too!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday at the community center—got it. I'll be there. Do we need me to bring anything specific, like tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? The Smiths are collecting broken appliances and furniture down at the community center—I heard Faye's bringing a lamp!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, I heard about that—some neighborhood fix-it thing. Might swing by if I have time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you should definitely try to make it! They're even going to have a few folks who know how to solder and stuff—might be fun to watch even if you don't bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, about that repair drive—did you actually see the damage? I'm trying to figure out if we should chip in for a proper fix or just patch it up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can come over and take a look with you—no need to guess when we can see it firsthand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, let's go check it together. I'd rather know exactly what we're dealing with before asking folks to open their wallets.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Opal, I'm so glad you stopped by! We're having a repair drive this Sunday at the community center — bring any broken items and we'll fix them together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Rosa, the repair drive is Saturday morning starting at 9, not Sunday. I've already marked the spot near Elm and Birch where the fence needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh honey, the date got changed to Sunday! Let me show you the new flyer — the community center's all set for us.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, let's get these tools laid out so we're ready when folks start arriving with their broken things.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, are we getting ready already? I thought it wasn't until later. Did the date change again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, same time—just figured we'd be ahead of the rush. Want to help me sort the screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community center and could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I've been hearing bits and pieces! Count me in—what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Ira! We're starting at 9 a.m. sharp. Bring any tools you can spare—hammers, screwdrivers, whatever works!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—I think it's Saturday, but I just can't remember if it's morning or afternoon. Thanks for offering to check the mailbox, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can swing by and check the mailbox right now, Oren. No trouble at all.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That'd be great, Sam—I really appreciate it. I think I tucked the sign-up sheet in there somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Faye, I'm glad you're here! We're collecting supplies for the repair drive — could you check if you have any spare tarps?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, sure thing, Cleo! I think I’ve got an old tarp in the garage from last year’s camping trip. I’ll bring it along on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye! That'll be a big help. See you Saturday morning, then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is officially organized? I haven't heard anything from the neighborhood association.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's not official, just me helping out. You need the drive now or later?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're organizing this yourself? No neighborhood association backing? That seems risky.
